sources: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 251947 (RIDB, cached trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

status.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/251947/month?start_date=2026-10-01 (October 2026 calendar: RV electric sites 005-020 Reserved/Available nightly through the month) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251947 (no closure notice among the active notices; 2026 Peak Season rate from 2026-07-25), read 2026-10-21

values.note: RV electric sites $24 a night (tent-only electric $24, tent-only non-electric $20); the rate table gives no separate price for the 12 standard non-electric sites.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251947/rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-07-25 to 2026-11-01: RV ELECTRIC 24, TENT ONLY ELECTRIC 24, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 20), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Notices: 'Reservations must be made in advance by utilizing either recreation.gov or by calling +1 (877) 444-6777', though the fee page adds 'On-site reservation subject to ranger availability' (card only, no cash or checks). 14 days in any 30. No more than 2 vehicles per site; no parking on the grass.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251947 (notices; facility_rules maxStay 14 nights / Rolling 30 Days; facility_use_fee_description), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 251947 (RIDB, cached trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20): the 16 RV ELECTRIC sites 005-020 list 50-amp; the 12 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites list no water or sewer hookup

values.note: 31 sites: 16 RV electric (005-020, one not reservable), 12 standard non-electric back-ins to 28 ft (21-32) and 3 tent-only electric (002-004). The catalog gives a length only for site 005 (50 ft) and the non-electric loop (28 ft).

sites.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 251947 (RIDB, cached trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (site types, Max Vehicle Length 50' on 005 and 28 on sites 21-32, Driveway Entry Back-in)

note: USACE (Norfolk District) on John W. Flannagan Reservoir (Cranesnest River arm), near Clintwood. --Claude
summary: Recreation.gov: the campground is operating again (October 2026 nights reserved/available on the RV electric loop, no closure notice), so status temporarily_closed (derived) -> open. Confirmed $24 RV electric, reservable on recreation.gov, 50-amp; added 14-night limit, 31 sites (16 RV electric, 12 non-electric to 28 ft, 3 tent), showers/water/dump, military discount. Count 30 -> 31. Note: dropped the site list and 'reservable online' (redundant) and the closure warning (contradicted by the calendar). Not stated: season, water/sewer at the electric sites.
